name: SelfDesign Learning Community

geo.address: PO Box 74560 RPO Kitsilano, Vancouver, BC V6K 4P4 (mailing only; no campus)
geo.coord_source: None: online school with a post-office-box mailing address; not mappable as a campus

description: Online K–12 independent school run by the SelfDesign Learning Foundation (since 1984). Each learner works one-on-one with a B.C.-certified 'Learning Consultant' on a personal learning plan built from the child's interests; assessment by weekly 'Observing for Learning' narratives rather than tests; graduates can earn the Dogwood. Group 1 independent online learning school; also runs an unfunded homeschool-registration service (SelfDesign Home Learning).

attributes.philosophy: Self-directed, relationship-centred, personalised learning; learner chooses the path to ministry competencies; parents are part of the learning team.

legal_status.label: Independent online learning school, Group 1 (Independent School Act, B.C.)
legal_status.province_category: Group 1 (all grade bands); Provincial Online Learning School (independent)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care

attributes.curriculum: B.C. curriculum through interest-based learning plans; Grade 10 'themes' include core Dogwood courses.
attributes.qualifications_offered: B.C. Certificate of Graduation (Dogwood), Adult Graduation Diploma, or School Completion (Evergreen) Certificate.
accreditation: Listed by the Ministry as an independent online learning school

tuition.notes: No fee schedule for B.C.-resident learners found on the official site on 2026-10-30. A search-engine excerpt of an older SelfDesign page says out-of-province learners pay tuition, unlike B.C. residents; not confirmed on a dated page. Late-application processing fee $50 per learner after 29–30 Sept 2026.

attributes.additional_fees: $50 processing fee for applications after late September 2026.
attributes.admission: Intake conversation; 2026-27 waitlisted for K–9 and full for 10–12 at the time of reading. Eligibility documents include citizenship/permanent-resident proof.
advantages: Closest Canadian analogue to Clonlara: learner-directed plan, certified mentor, distance delivery, recognised diploma
Family can live anywhere in B.C.
Pathway to Dogwood and university admission
limitations: Only B.C. residents can enrol in the ministry-funded programme; newcomers must establish B.C. residency/eligibility
attributes.qualifying_reason: Model, legal status and diploma pathway verified on the official site and ministry list; cost to families not published, so SPEC §7 'tuition with its school year' is unmet. Confirm by email (enrolment@selfdesign.org).
